query:
-- The Orange Curtain Review (30005)
INSERT INTO newsTags (newsId, tagId)
SELECT 30005, id FROM tags WHERE slug IN ('reviews-press', 'regional-theatre', 'musical-theatre')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM newsTags WHERE newsId = 30005 AND tagId = tags.id);

-- Making My SCR Debut (1)
INSERT INTO newsTags (newsId, tagId)
SELECT 1, id FROM tags WHERE slug IN ('production-debuts', 'regional-theatre', 'musical-theatre')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM newsTags WHERE newsId = 1 AND tagId = tags.id);

-- Assisting Tom Buderwitz (2)
INSERT INTO newsTags (newsId, tagId)
SELECT 2, id FROM tags WHERE slug IN ('collaborations', 'regional-theatre', 'professional-development')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM newsTags WHERE newsId = 2 AND tagId = tags.id);

INSERT INTO newsTags (newsId, tagId)
